name: random_inclusive
comment: Random integer 0..maximum inclusive.

name: projectile_context_begin
comment: Clamps the percentage 0..100 into context +0xE8 and the low 24 colour bits into +0xEC, as NA2's 0x0010D220.

name: projectile_context_end
comment: Clears context +0xE8, as NA2's 0x0010D200.

name: mission_apply_battle_record
comment: Reads a 0x52-byte eventBattle.ccbpm record; scene halfword at +0x2A.

name: stage_format_archive_path
comment: Formats the stage folder prefix and the scene's archive name.

name: bg_control_load_scene
comment: Loads the scene archive and BIN_bgdata, builds player positions, safe position, change lines and section lines from markers, constructs the scenes, loads DMY_cpmin/cpmax/cvmin/cvmax camera bounds.

name: bg_build_change_lines
comment: Reads DMY_<f|b>[n]_cl_<k>_nor/end/mov pairs as typed lines per section, as NA2's first-family lines.

name: bg_build_section_lines
comment: For sections 1..4 reads DMY_line_0n0 marker pairs (stem, stem_1, stem_2..; up to 32 pairs; variants stem1..3) as floor segments and walkable lines; DMY_linemin/max0n bound each section.

name: bg_load_player_positions
comment: DMY_pp1_010..DMY_pp9_010 into bg +0x600, zero when absent.

name: bg_control_load_safe_position
comment: DMY_safe_pos into bg +0x6A0, (0,0,0,1) when absent.

name: bg_crash_break_reborn_parse
comment: Factory 134: bomb, second object or 0, spot stem (<stem>_a<n>, up to 8), blast radius, away updates (90), fuse updates (150).

name: bg_crash_break_reborn_update
comment: States: 1 fuse (red pulse, last 15% blink and swell to 2), 2 blast (16 updates of hits within the radius), 3 away hidden 200 below a random spot, 4 rise over 30; holds while stage updates are restricted.

name: bg_crash_break_reborn_draw
comment: Rising: plain; fuse: tinted red by sin(angle) x 50 percent through projectile_context_begin.

name: bg_crash_break_reborn_blast
comment: Plays effect0x ANM_e0x_bom0 jittered +-10 and turned on z, a type-6 screen effect (0x08B39190), and sound 0x1011.

name: bg_flicker_object_update
comment: Every 30 updates starts a flicker with chance/3001; toggles opacity 0/1 each update for 2..4 updates, then 1.

name: bg_flicker_object_parse
comment: Factory 135: object, marker or 0, flicker chance in 3001.

name: bg_factory_fog
comment: Factory 10: RGB, near/far percentages, near/far distances, NA2's tokens.

name: bg_factory_render_coefficients
comment: Factory 17: first token to 0x08CDDA48, second to 0x08CDDA44.

name: stage_select_build_available_list
comment: Scans the 13 Stage Select rows in order, keeping scenes whose availability bit is set.

name: camera_track_stage
comment: Normal-stage camera: frames the fighters by mode, clamps to the stage markers (0x089599F0), eases eye and target by 0.3 per update.

name: camera_frame_fighter_box
comment: Mode 0: target = fighters' bounding-box centre + (0,0,75); eye = target - (0,d,-0.22d), d = max(800, 2 x box diagonal).

name: mission_top_level_camera_track
comment: Scene 35 (r023) camera with fixed bounds 0x08B47AF0.

name: camera_clamp_to_stage_bounds
comment: Clamps the eye per axis to bg +0x6B0/+0x6C0 (DMY_cpmin/cpmax), moving it back by any lateral overshoot, and the target to +0x6D0/+0x6E0 (DMY_cvmin/cvmax).

name: mission_camera_track
comment: Mission camera from six scene-minus-13 vector tables at 0x08B47B90..0x08B484A0; eases 0.2.

name: battle_camera_update_by_scene_kind
comment: Normal scenes 0x08958724; mission scene 35 0x089592C4; other missions 0x08959B74.

name: stage_get_name_text
comment: Resolves the scene's name text entry.

name: stage_is_mission_scene
comment: 1 for scenes 13..41 (r001..r029, Master Road missions), 0 below 13; -1 argument reads the active scene.

name: mission_stage_load_auxiliary_archives
comment: For mission scenes loads gim.ccs and 13adv e000/e007/e300 and the mission's object resources.

name: fighter_place_pair_at_safe_position
comment: Places a paired action's two fighters side by side at DMY_safe_pos on section 0.

name: stage_get_default_bgm_member
comment: Scene's default track for scenes 0..41, else -1.

name: stage_camera_marker_defaults
comment: Eye min/max and target min/max used when the archive lacks DMY_cpmin/cpmax/cvmin/cvmax.

name: crash_break_reborn_responses
comment: Time-bomb hit responses 0x12,0x14,0x10,0x11,0x0B,0x0C,0x0D,0x0E, chosen by random(7).

name: stage_select_records
comment: Stage Select rows: scene, name frame, big and small picture objects; order 0,6,7,8,1,4,5,3,12,11,2,10,9.

name: stage_name_text_ids
comment: Scene name text entries in 01text/text_*.bin: 160..199, then 181/182 again for r028/r029.

name: stage_archive_names
comment: Scene-indexed stage archive names: s01..s10,s13,s21,s22 (scenes 0..12), then r001..r029 (Master Road missions 13..41).

name: bg_record_factories
comment: BIN_bgdata factory table; NA2's numbering plus 134 ccBgCrashBreakRebornBattle, 135 flicker object, 139 ccBgFogCtrl, 151.

name: stage_default_bgm_members
comment: Default sound/bgm.afs member per scene.
